desc_zh: 适用于户外围挡、建筑及大型展示场景的定制网格布印刷成品。
desc_en: Custom-printed mesh banners for outdoor fencing, building wraps and large-format display applications.

detail_zh.lead: 面向户外大型画面的定制 PVC 网格布喷绘成品，适用于项目指定使用网格结构的展示场景。每个订单均按成品尺寸和安装需求评估。
highlights: 根据项目尺寸定制生产
短边约 5 米无拼接生产能力，须按画面尺寸评估
支持包边、打鸡眼扣、加绳及穿杆袋
applications: 户外围挡及施工现场画面
delivery: 根据订单核算包装和运费
detail_zh.artwork: 客户可以提供印刷文件。基础文件检查和简单调整可免费提供；较大幅度修改或从零设计需单独报价。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供成品尺寸、数量、设计文件、安装方式、加工要求、交付形式及目的地。
detail_zh.caveat: 约 5 米无拼接能力取决于具体长宽组合。产品是否适合特定安装环境，应结合项目要求确认。

detail_en.lead: Custom printed PVC mesh banners for large outdoor graphics where a mesh construction is specified. Finished dimensions and installation details are reviewed for each project.
highlights: Made to the dimensions of your project
Approx. 5 m seamless shorter-side capability, subject to artwork dimensions and production assessment
Hemming, eyelets, rope finishing and pole pockets available
delivery: Packing and freight assessed for the order
detail_en.artwork: Print-ready artwork can be supplied by the buyer. Basic file checks and minor adjustments are available at no extra cost; extensive artwork changes or original design work are quoted separately.
detail_en.brief: Please share finished dimensions, quantity, artwork, installation method, finishing details, delivery format and destination.
detail_en.caveat: The approximately 5 m seamless capability is subject to the exact width-and-height combination. Suitability for a particular installation should be confirmed against the project requirements.
